name: External Type Of Party 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external type of party code in the format of a character string with a maximum length of 4 characters. The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

APPL.name: Applicant
APPL.definition: Party named in the undertaking as the “applicant”.

BENE.name: Beneficiary
BENE.definition: Party in whose favour the undertaking (or counter-undertaking) is issued.

CONF.name: Confirmation Party
CONF.definition: Party that adds its undertaking to honour the undertaking.

ISSU.name: Issuer
ISSU.definition: Party that issues the undertaking (or counter-undertaking).

OBLG.name: Obligor
OBLG.definition: Party obligated to reimburse the issuer.

ORDR.name: Ordering Party
ORDR.definition: Party requested to issue an undertaking on behalf of the applicant. Also known as the ordering institution or applicant's bank.
